title: How Does Domestic Tourism in Uzbekistan Impact the Local Culture and Community?
content: Economic benefits are the main part of domestic tourism which will generate economic stimulation, job creation as well and development infrastructure. Developing social and cultural schemes among citizens who live in suburban areas is to help increase the income of local citizens. The purpose of this study is to identify the average percentage of domestic tourism between adults and the younger generation. Although it has some difficult points to verify between different ages, it could aid in increasing the income of local tourism. Using survey questions among people to point out the average income as well as the advantages side of domestic tourism. Furthermore, this survey analyzed quantitative and qualitative of inbound tourism among local citizens. Age, Cost of Living, and Residential Placement are examples of quantitative. Cultural Events and Tourism Management are examples of qualitative. This survey has used ordinal regression. Because of numbers, percentages have been recognized by the SPSS platform.According to the study it has been used logistic regression. As well as it has been showed more statistically significant than insignificant. It has an equal negative relationship.For example; -16.285,p=0.003. -7.380p=0.004.As well as it has also been conducted by researchers to verify specific numbers among individuals. According to the survey, researchers could identify neutral and high levels of balance in the tourism sphere. Especially, it has been regulated by researchers "How impact inbound tourism on the community question we know how many people could do answer this question. By the way, it consists of some other main parts of this survey to check the willingness of humans and how they are interested in the tourism sphere.
